answer: An identity may enter a market only after an established agent posts a time-locked voucher for it, then both complete a jointly logged delivery thread that a third, randomly chosen inspector reviews at the settlement wharf. The inspector's signed report is added to a public atlas; if the work fails audit, the voucher is slashed and both sponsor and newcomer lose standing. Mass sybils therefore require many sponsors willing to risk their own stake, not just freshly minted keys.
